name: http
description: Fetch web pages and call external HTTP APIs (SSRF-protected outbound requests). Load to pull data from, or push data to, the open web.

content.inline:
## HTTP / Web
- get `{url, headers?}` fetches a resource; post `{url, body, headers?}` sends data. Responses carry status, headers and body text.
- URL-encode query values with `v/ops/jvm/url-encode` before interpolating them.

Rules:
- Requests are SSRF-protected and pass the venue operator's allow/block lists — a refusal names the policy, not a network fault.
- Credentials in headers should come from secret refs (`s/<name>`), never inline tokens.
- Prefer structured APIs over scraping; check a response's status before trusting its body; large bodies count against your context — extract what you need and store the rest (workspace or assets) rather than re-fetching.
- For another VENUE, use grid ops (hash-verified, identity-carrying) — http is for the outside web.
